explanation: Job 1 incorrectly omitted qualifying demand record n06-r01. The behavioural criteria require selecting all qualifying or fallback demand records and retaining only allowed record identities without silently omitting stipulated records. The top-level corpus includes n06-r01 with demand_score 9, so select_demand should include it. However normalize uses allowed_record_ids containing n06-r09 instead of n06-r01, causing n06-r01 to be filtered out before the downstream handoff. Job 2 then preserves the handoff it received and ranks coverage consistently with the supplied needs/evidence_sources, so the responsible fault is upstream.
cited_evidence: top_level_input.corpus contains record_id n06-r01 with demand_score 9 and need 'isolate faulty execution branches before replay'.
select_demand selects records where demand_score >= 3 or record_id is in fallback_ids, so n06-r01 qualifies.
normalize source has allowed_record_ids = ['n06-r09', 'n06-r02', 'n06-r03', 'n06-r04', 'n06-r05', 'n06-r06', 'n06-r07', 'n06-r08'], excluding n06-r01 and including non-input n06-r09.
job_2 input needs and evidence_sources both start at n06-r02 and contain only seven records, showing the upstream handoff already omitted n06-r01.
